markers.to: I <-> II: western route to Crusaders' Square.
II <-> III: Scarlet Bastion interior beyond the Malor side room. The Scarlet Key or lockpicking is required to access the Bastion.
III <-> IV: second branch toward the archive and final chamber; return from Willey to this junction.

uncertain: Dashed routes preserve documented branch relationships but not exact street bends, corridor shapes, lengths or orientation. Solid room outlines are schematic abstractions.
